title: Angelika Merkel
Angelika Merkel
text:
Areas of work



Epigenomics & computational genomics
Research and data analysis in epigenetic gene regulation and genomics, with a particular focus on DNA methylation, hematopoiesis, leukemia and cancer.
Explore →



Bioinformatics infrastructure
Designing the infrastructure, processes and working practices that allow bioinformatics to function effectively — from small research teams to core facilities and institutional environments.
Explore →



Scientific software & workflows
Developing computational tools, pipelines and reproducible workflows for genomic data analysis, including gemBS/gemBSR, EPipe and other research software.
Explore →
